description: COLUMBUS—State Senator Bob Peterson  (R-Washington Court House) touted last week's Senate passage of his legislation to cut bureaucratic red tape by reducing burdensome regulations as a major victory for Ohio businesses. The measure brings Ohio more in line with national averages. Joined

title: Peterson Votes to Cut Burdensome Regulations by 30 Percent Over Three Years — Bob Peterson
